reader_notes: Q1 option C compresses 'inte redan hade något högt att se upp mot' into 'där staden i övrigt var låg' — a fair paraphrase, and clearly the only defensible option once D's 'oavsett vilka andra höga byggnader' is checked against Vidmark.
Q2 cleanly separates three delay/idle anecdotes (Tövedal expropriation, Silvberga lanternin vote, Almsjö pump) across its distractors — good discrimination work for a careful reader.
Q3's distractor A recycles Rahmqvist's own methodological self-objection (1958 criteria change) as if it were Sandell's — a well-made attribution trap.
Swedish is idiomatic and period-appropriate throughout ('Låg tomten lågt, fick bygget bli desto högre'; 'står i längderna skriven'); no grammar issues found.
